# Geometry lines where nimkivy is known to differ from Kivy, each with its cause.
# Format: scene | Kivy's line | nimkivy's line   (any other difference fails)
# SDL3_ttf measures one word a pixel narrower than Kivy's SDL2_ttf (PORTING.md, Gaps, core/text/text_sdl3).
